# Grafana

Owned by Person 1 (Saadia). This kit keeps only what `docker/docker-compose.yml` mounts, so that the stack starts and you can see your Zabbix data in a dashboard:

* `provisioning/` registers the Zabbix and NMS API data sources and the dashboard folder.
* `dashboards/nms-operations.json` is the generated dashboard. It reads the Zabbix items named `ICMP ping`, `ICMP response time` and `ICMP loss`, which `monitoring-zabbix/templates/` creates. It is generated by `scripts/build_grafana_dashboard.py` in the full repository; edit that script there, never this JSON.

Part A does not change anything in this folder.
